summary: Your emotions and your discipline can work together, but only when you reach for it. You can give a feeling the time and structure it needs instead of judging it. You just have to choose to.
body: Your emotions and your discipline can work together, but only when you reach for it. You can give a feeling the time and structure it needs instead of judging it. You just have to choose to. Left alone, the two ignore each other, and you swing between feeling too much and shutting it all down. Bring a little structure to your emotional life, name what you need, give yourself room to process at your own speed, and it steadies you fast. The opening is always there. It rewards you every time you take it.
gift: At your best: emotionally honest and grounded, able to give your feelings both room and shape.
shadow: The trap: leaving the tool in the drawer, then wondering why you feel all over the place.
integration: Let emotional needs and discipline and limits cooperate without making either one carry the whole story. Dependable under pressure; the risk is grinding joylessly.
do: Give a feeling structure instead of judging it
Process at your own speed, on purpose
Reach for the steadiness before you're underwater
dont: Wait for it to happen on its own
